The '''Jaltiri tribes''' were a cultural or/and planetary community that inhabited the world of [[Toskhowwl VI]]<ref name="SM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Around [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the Jaltiri tribals were known beyond their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] for their custom of constructing stacks made from severed heads.<ref name="SM" />
